40' 0 - 2 Mahdi Camara (Brest) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the left post. What a lovely finish!
39' Brest seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

36' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the corner but it's cleared.

30' The current number of shots on goal is 0:4.

28' The most active player in today's match is definitely Angelo (Strasbourg). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
24' Kenny Lala (Brest) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.

6' Martin Satriano (Brest) picks up a long through ball, but Alaa Bellaarouch deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
5' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alaa Bellaarouch intercepts the ball.
